reviews.title: Has worked great for me for 7 years or so now.
reviews.body:
I am a male and don't pay much attention to what I use for my hair.
But what I often do is research heavily online into what to purchase. I found that this brand, TRESemme, was rated very highly and was also very inexpensive.

I have never had an issue with their brand and have used them for about 7 years now. I doubt there's much regulation on shampoo, so I'm not sure which is better than another of their brand, or if there is even a noticeable difference. Either way, it doesn't matter to me. I've been happy with them for eight years and I love to complain. I haven't with this shampoo and that means I am recommending this brand.

reviews.title: Small, ideal for children to small teenagers.
reviews.body:
It's good for an average sized person. I'm a big man 6'3" 250 lbs and this thing is kinda small. I fit my gym gear in here. 1 pair of lifting shoes size 12, some wrist wraps and knee sleeves, 1 power lifting belt and 1 nylon belt. This thing is packed to the max with these items. I'd recommend this for a middle schooler kid at best. Probably even too small for a high school student. I cut out the laptop sleeve that's in the main compartment because it was literally getting in the way nonstop. That made it so much better. But the 2 side pockets for water bottles are so tiny I can barely even fit a generic 12 oz water bottle in it. (you know the bottle of water that comes in the 24 pack that you get at the store)

All n all it fits its purpose, but just not for men. I'm only using it cause I have it. I wouldn't buy this product for myself knowing what I know now and maybe if it was much larger I would. Also theres no clip to attach the shoulder straps across your chest. So you're constantly pulling the tabs down on the straps to secure it on your body. Which makes it a pain in the butt to take off and on constantly. So I end up carrying it alot of the time by the top hoop handle. Which kinda defeats the purpose of the backpack. However the material seems durable and breathable and high quality. As well as the zippers, those seem sturdy and well made.

reviews.title: Very cute but doesn't fit over pants and a strap broke in first week
reviews.body: When these first arrived we loved them.  They're very cute and seemed to fit our toddler just fine (he wears a 5 shoe so we ordered a 5 in the boots).  We got them for a fall beach trip, and we quickly discovered that while they fit fine over just socks, there's not enough room in the leg to wear over pants.  Since it was cold at the beach, we really needed him bundled up but couldn't use these boots over regular clothes.  We ended up putting him in sleepers with feet every time we went out to the water since they were close-fitting enough to fit in the boot.  That worked at the beach but doesn't really help for everyday use.  Then at the end of the first week while pulling the boots on (not pulling particularly hard), one of the straps just snapped.  So we basically got one week of use out of these and could only use them with pajamas.  So for sizing I would say it's a true fit if your kid is going to wear them with shorts, but buy a bigger size if you need them in cool weather.  And the loops are apparently just for decoration.  For the one week he used them, they did seem very water proof--we didn't have any leaks.  I wish I could return them but I waited too long to get around to it!

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY! READ THE REVIEWS!
reviews.body:
I have had a pair of Western Chief rain boots for 10+ years. They are still good in the rain but are showing their age. I decided to buy a new pair for a trip next week thinking I would have not problems with them. Unfortunately the quality is not what it was 10 years ago. The first thing I noticed when I opened them (from a plastic shipping bag NO BOX) was the rubber that was sprayed on had bubbles and holes. At first I thought it would be OK since they were to be worn in the rain and not for looks. Then I called Amazon to see what their return policy was for a defective item that had been worn. I really wasn't sure I got the correct answer, but he told me that if they had been worn I could not return them for a refund, even if they were defective. I am usually satisfied with Amazon and if I have a problem they handle it. I have decided to return the NEW boots and to contact Wester Chief's corporate office. I know that some online vendors sell 2nds and after reading several negative reviews about them leaking and falling apart, I won't be keeping these. It's such a shame that we can no longer have faith in a name brand product. And that Amazon won't stand behind the products that they sell.

UPDATE: I did contact Western Chief office and was pleased with the response I got. They promised they backed their products and gave me a % discount. After my trip I purchased a pair DIRECT from Western Chief. As far as I can tell they are in perfect condition. We haven't had rain yet but I am satisfied with the boots and will buy direct from them in the future. I have had this problem with Skechers that I bought through a B2B and not from the maker. Lessons learned for me.

reviews.title: I wanted to LOVE these
reviews.body:
I love these boots. They are very cute! It makes me feel special when I'm in my garden.

The only reason that I am giving these a four star rating is because I think that these run a little small. Specifically, they are more narrow than I am used to. I do have a wide foot and usually wear an 8.5 wide. If no wide width is available then I size up and usually have no issues. These are advertised as regular width, not narrow.

This is my second pair of Western Chief rain boots/gardening boots. My other pair are not mid calf, but low calf (?). Those are also a size 9, regular width. I can wear thick socks in those and still be able to slip my foot inside the boot with pulling it on. I can only wear thin socks with this pair of boots and pray that my feet don't swell. That actually happened and I was in pain from my right boot squeezing my foot. I started to get cramps along the top of my foot and had to go home and get my other boots.

Honestly, these are lovely boots and if you have narrower feet then these should fit you very well. If you're like me with wide feet, the bare minimum is to go up a half size. I would have gone up to a 10, but they would be too long.

These are made very well with quality materials. I would recommend these with the above caveats.
